effects.text:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}} '''Effects''' are certain conditions and modifiers that impact gameplay in various ways. These effects are viewable on the [[Galactic War|Galactic Map]]. The number of Effects and type vary by [[Biome]], [[Factions|Faction]], and [[Difficulty]]. ==Weapons Experimentation/Arsenal Augmentation== Occasionally, [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] High Command makes certain [[Stratagems]] available for [[Helldiver]]s to deploy with as an additional mission standard-issue stratagem. These augmentations are purely additive and do not take up a slot on a Helldiver's Stratagem loadout. == Democracy Space Station == The [[Democracy Space Station]] can provide a Helldiver-funded "Tactical Action" in addition to the Liberation Campaign boosting "Operational Support" to whichever planet is being orbited.
{{DSS Action|Eagle Storm}} {{DSS Action|Orbital Blockade}} {{DSS Action|Heavy Ordnance Distribution}}
{{DSS Action|Effects}}
==Environmental Conditions== Environmental conditions refer to geophysical events that influence a [[Planets and Sectors|Planet's]] environment, experienced throughout [[missions]]. * {{Environmental Conditions|Acid Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Blizzards}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Extreme Cold}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Fire Tornados}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Ion Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Meteor Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Sandstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Thick Fog}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Tremors}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Volcanic Activity}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Heavy Gloom Shroud}} * '''Moderate Gloom Blanket:''' The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%. * '''Light Gloom Cover:''' Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds. * '''[[Hive World|Gloom Source]]:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%. ===Operational Effects=== Sometimes, during certain events or Major Orders, some, if not all planets may gain an extra effect/modifier, available on all difficulties. * '''Orbital Fluctuations:''' All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown. ''(not to be confused with the Operation Modifier with the same name, this effect only affects [[Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]])'' * '''Medical Supply Strain:''' Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by 1. * '''Pilot Shortage:''' Extraction takes 30 additional seconds. * '''Slower Eagle Rearm:''' Eagle Rearm time is 25% slower. ==Operation Modifiers== Operation Modifiers are added obstacles that Helldivers must handle on the battlefield. A single Modifier will appear on {{Difficulty|5}}, increasing to two at {{Difficulty|8}}. Operation Modifiers do not appear on planets undergoing a [[Second Galactic War Mechanics#Defense Campaigns|Defense Campaign.]] ===General=== *[[Complex Stratagem Plotting]] – Stratagem Call-in time increased by 50%. *[[Orbital Fluctuations]] – Stratagem cooldown increased by 25%. *[[Poor Intel]] – Objective locations are hidden. *[[Civilians and SEAF in Area]] - [[SEAF Soldier]] squads and [[Civilian|Civilians]] are both on the battlefield. (Event modifier only present in [[Biomes#City Biomes|Metropolis Biomes]]) ===Faction-Specific=== {{Terminid|text}} *[[Atmospheric Spores]] – Map obscured by Bug Spores. *[[Roving Shriekers]] - Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield. {{Automaton|text}} *[[Gunship Patrols]] - Flying Gunships patrol the battlefield. {{Illuminate|text}} *[[Leviathan Blockade]] - Flying Leviathan warships patrol the battlefield. ===Removed=== *[[AA Defenses]] – Stratagem slots reduced by 1. *[[Atmospheric Interference]] – Orbital Stratagems Scatter Increased. *[[Electronic Countermeasures]] – Stratagem Codes Scrambled. == Combatant Forces == Some planets or cities will have modifiers that affect the types of units that spawn, whether it be friendly units or enemy ones, with them either increasing the frequency of specific units, replacing certain units with unique variants, or having entirely unique units. '''{{Terminid|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Predator Strain]] - Unique cunning variants of [[Predator Hunter|Hunters]] and [[Predator Stalker|Stalkers]] will appear. ** [[Rupture Strain]] - Unique burrowing variants of [[Rupture Warrior|Warriors]], [[Rupture Spewer|Spewers]] and [[Rupture Charger|Chargers]] will appear. ** [[Spore Burst Strain]] - Unique explosive variants of [[Spore Burst Scavenger|Scavengers]], [[Spore Burst Hunter|Hunter]]s and [[Spore Burst Warrior|Warriors]] will appear. ** [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] - [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] will be replaced with a unique flying enemy; the [[Dragonroach|Dragonroach.]] ** [[Hive Lord|Hive Lords]] - The colossal worm-like [[Hive Lord]] will appear. (Requires {{Difficulty|7}} or above.) '''{{Automaton|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Jet Brigade]] - Unique [[Assault Raider]] units will appear alongside jetpack-equipped variants of [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Troopers]], [[Jet Brigade MG Raider|MG Raiders]], [[Jet Brigade Commissar|Commissars]], [[Jet Brigade Devastator|Devastators]], [[Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher|Hulk Scorchers]] and [[Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser|Hulk Bruisers]]. ** [[Incineration Corps]] - Unique [[Conflagration Devastator]] and [[Hulk Firebomber]] units will appear alongside incendiary-wielding variants of [[Pyro Trooper|Troopers]], [[Incendiary Rocket Raider|Rocket Raiders]] and [[Incendiary MG Devastator|Heavy Devastators]]. ** [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborgs]] - Unique cyborg [[Agitator]], [[Radical]] and [[Vox Engine]] units will appear. * Enemy Divisions: ** Hulk Surge - [[Hulk|Hulk units]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Heavy Armor Surge - [[Tank|Tanks]] and [[Strider|Striders]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Devastator Surge - [[Devastator]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Illuminate|text}}''' * Subfaction: ** [[Appropriators]] - Unique [[Obtruder]], [[Veracitor]], and [[Gatekeeper]] units will appear. ** [[Vote Snatchers]] - Unique [[Wretch]] and [[Crusher]] units will appear * Enemy Division: ** [[Mindless Masses]] - [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]] units will spawn with increased frequency. ** [[Invasion Fleet]] - [[Voteless]], [[Overseer]], [[Crescent Overseer]], [[Elevated Overseer]], [[Fleshmob]], [[Watcher]], [[Harvester]] and [[Stingray]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Super Earth|text= Federation of Super Earth}} *Division: ** [[Heavy SEAF Presence]] - [[SEAF Soldier]]s will be deployed into mission areas via [[Pelican Shuttle|Pelican Shuttles]]. == Other Effects == === Armor Passives === [[Armor Passives]] are unique, player-specific abilities or enhancements that are tied to their corresponding body armors. Depending on the perk, different stat(s) will be affected, altering the way Helldivers can operate in the mission. === Boosters === Each Helldiver has the option to equip a [[Boosters|booster]] before deployment, which applies buff to the entire squad. Depending on the booster, it can alter a Helldiver's stats, certain pieces of equipment, or mission mechanics. === Status Effects === [[Status Effects]] are various status effects that can alter the Helldiver or their Enemies. These range to effects from the burning or gas effects of specific weaponry, to effects from stratagems, enemies, or environmental conditions. === Physical Conditions === [[Physical Conditions]] refer to adverse effects that a Helldiver may experience on the battlefield. These conditions can range from minor debuffs to being fatal if left untreated. Depending on the condition, it can be self-inflicted, caused by the environment, or applied by an enemy attack. [[Category:Effects|!]] [[Category:Missions|!]] [[zh:效果]]

{{Tabs | name1 = Helldivers 2 | link1 = Status Effects | name2 = Helldivers 1 | link2 = Helldivers 1:Status Effects }} {{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}} There are various status effects that can alter the [[Helldiver]] or their [[Enemies]]. The following effects exist in Helldivers 2. == Stagger and Ragdoll == Staggering can range from mere flinching to being knocked off your feet entirely. It is caused by dealing or taking damage with sufficient Stagger Force to meet an enemy's stagger thresholds. Higher thresholds impart stronger effects, such as completely interrupting animations. Unlike other status effects, Stagger Force does not build up over multiple attacks. ==== Enemies ==== * Staggering will cause an enemy to be pushed back and usually interrupts their movement, with the distance pushed scaling with Stagger Force. * Most enemies have abilities that can be interrupted upon being attacked with sufficient Stagger Force. ** Some notable interruptable abilities include certain attacks and calling for reinforcements. ** Stagger thresholds listed on enemy pages will be the value required to cause interrupting stagger. * Stagger Force required to interrupt an enemy can vary wildely, from the lowely [[Scavenger|Scavenger's]] 1 to the unyielding [[Fleshmob|Fleshmob's]] 45. * Weapons that fire multiple projectiles (Such as the [[SG-8 Punisher]]) will have every projectile apply full Stagger Force, allowing just a single pellet to stagger an enemy. ==== Stagger Force vs. Enemies ==== {| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"flamer |+ Stagger Threshold Table ! rowspan="30" | {{Automatons|text}} | [[Assault Raider|Assault Raider]] || 10 |- | [[Brawler|Brawler]] || 10 |- | [[Commissar|Commissar]] || 10 |- | [[Incendiary Rocket Raider|Incendiary Rocket Raider]] || 10 |- | [[Jet Brigade Commissar|Jet Brigade Commissar]] || 10 |- | [[Jet Brigade MG Raider|Jet Brigade MG Raider]] || 10 |- | [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Jet Brigade Trooper]] || 10 |- | [[MG Raider|MG Raider]] || 10 |- | [[Marauder|Marauder]] || 10 |- | [[Pyro Trooper|Pyro Trooper]] || 10 |- | [[Rocket Raider|Rocket Raider]] || 10 |- | [[Trooper|Trooper]] || 10 |- | [[Agitator|Agitator]] || 20 |- | [[Radical|Radical]] || 20 |- | [[Berserker|Berserker]] || 30 |- | [[Conflagration Devastator|Conflagration Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Devastator|Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Heavy Devastator|Heavy Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Incendiary MG Devastator|Incendiary MG Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Jet Brigade Devastator|Jet Brigade Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Reinforced Scout Strider|Reinforced Scout Strider]] || 30 |- | [[Rocket Devastator|Rocket Devastator]] || 30 |- | [[Scout Strider|Scout Strider]] || 30 |- | [[Hulk Bruiser|Hulk Bruiser]] || 40 |- | [[Hulk Firebomber|Hulk Firebomber]] || 40 |- | [[Hulk Obliterator|Hulk Obliterator]] || 40 |- | [[Hulk Scorcher|Hulk Scorcher]] || 40 |- | [[Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser|Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser]] || 40 |- | [[Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher|Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher]] || 40 |- | [[War Strider|War Strider]] || 40 |- ! rowspan="8" | {{Illuminate|text}} | [[Voteless|Voteless]] || 1 |- | [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseer]] || 30 |- | [[Crescent Overseer|Crescent Overseer]] || 35 |- | [[Overseer|Overseer]] || 35 |- | [[Gatekeeper|Gatekeeper]] || 40 |- | [[Harvester|Harvester]] || 40 |- | [[Veracitor|Veracitor]] || 40 |- | [[Fleshmob|Fleshmob]] || 45 |} ==== Helldivers ==== * Helldivers that are hit by any enemy attack will flinch, causing their reticle to be thrown off the point of aim temporarily. * Helldivers that are hit by enemy attacks with a stagger value of '''10''' or greater will be staggered. This will interrupt certain animations, such as stimming. * Helldivers that are hit by enemy attacks with a stagger value of '''25''' or greater will be ragdolled. This throws the player, interrupts all animations, stops actions like typing on a terminal, and temporarily takes away all player control. This does, however, have a plus of providing '''90%''' explosion damage reduction while in this state. * The [[Rock Solid]] armor passive '''reduces''' incoming stagger by '''30%'''. This enables you to avoid being ragdolled by many attacks, such as [[Rocket Devastator]] rockets, Devastator punches, and [[Overseer]] staff swings, but not stronger attacks like [[Cannon Turret]] shots or [[Reinforced Scout Strider]] rockets. ** Attacks with stagger force values of 36 or above can ragdoll you with the Rock Solid Passive. == Acid Splash == * Acid covered targets will be slowed and may additionally take damage over time. This effect lasts 4 seconds. * Can be inflicted by the following [[Terminids|Terminid]] Enemies: [[Caustic Spitter|Caustic Spitters]], [[Hunter|Hunters]], [[Caustic Warrior|Caustic Warriors]], [[Caustic Spewer|Caustic Spewers]], [[Nursing Spewer|Nursing Spewers]], [[Caustic Charger|Caustic Chargers]], [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]], [[Bug Mine|Bug Mines]], [[Predator Hunter|Predator Hunters]], and all [[Spore Burst Strain|Spore Burst Strain Terminids]]. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Acid Splash}} == Bleed == Inflicted on Helldivers from being injured in the chest or from coming into contact with either a [[Spike Plant|Spike Plant]] or a [[Automaton Barbed Wire|Barbed Wire]]. These all counts as separate effects. Deals damage over time.
{{Attack_Data/attack|status|Bleed}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Thornbush}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Barbwire}}
== Fire == * Can be inflicted by most fire-based weapons and stratagems;
Notable fire threats [[Environmental Hazards]] *[[Exploding barrels]] *[[Fire tornadoes]] *[[Volcano plants]] [[Enemies]] *Specific [[Automaton]]s **[[Hulk Scorcher]]s **[[Incineration Corps]] ***[[Pyro Trooper]]s ***[[Incendiary MG Devastator]]s ***[[Conflagration Devastator]]s ***[[Incendiary Rocket Devastator]] ***[[Hulk Firebomber]]s *[[Terminids|Terminid]] [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] *[[Illuminate]] laser weapons **[[Harvester|Harvesters]] **[[Gazer|Gazers]] [[Helldiver]]s *[[Primary weapon]]s **[[AR-2 Coyote]] **[[SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker]] **[[FLAM-66 Torcher]] **[[LAS-5 Scythe]] **[[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle]] (overheating) **[[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]] **[[SG-451 Cookout]] *[[Secondary weapon]]s **[[LAS-7 Dagger]] **[[P-72 Crisper]] *[[Throwable]]s **[[G-10 Incendiary]] **[[G-13 Incendiary Impact]] **[[G-142 Pyrotech]] *[[Support weapon]]s **[[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]] **[[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]] **[[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]] **[[EAT-700 Expendable Napalm]] *[[Stratagem]]s **[[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]] **[[A/LAS-98 Laser Sentry]] **[[Eagle Napalm Airstrike]] **[[Orbital Napalm Barrage]] **[[AX/FLAM-75 Hot Dog]] **[[AX/LAS-5 Rover]] **[[MD-I4 Incendiary Mines|MD-14 Incendiary Mines]]
Fire damage can penetrate {{Armor|4|AP}} armor and has an unmodified duration of 3 seconds. * Many entities have a fire damage multiplier. ** For instance, [[Caustic Spewer|Caustic Spewers]] take the standard amount of fire damage, but [[Impaler|Impalers]] take a 1.7x Fire Damage Multiplier due to being a larger enemy. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Fire}} == Fire Panic == An effect similar to [[Status_Effects#Gas Confusion Mk1|Gas Confusion]], enemies hit by a direct stream of fire will move and attack randomly. Only direct-flame firing weapons such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], [[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]], [[FLAM-66 Torcher]], and (uniquely) [[40-K Meltagun]] can apply this effect. Large/Massive non-[[Terminids|Terminid]] enemies are immune to this effect. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Fire_Panic}} == Flamer Slowed == Enemies being hit by a direct stream of fire will be slowed. Only direct-flame firing weapons such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], [[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]], [[FLAM-66 Torcher]], and (uniquely) [[40-K Meltagun]] can apply this effect. Large/Massive non-[[Terminids|Terminid]] enemies are immune to this effect. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|FlamerSlowed}} == Burning Heavy == An additional fire DPS inflicted by [[Eagle Napalm Airstrike]] and [[Orbital Napalm Barrage]], or shooting an enemy with the [[EAT-700 Expendable Napalm|Expendable Napalm]]. It inflicts significantly more damage than standard burning, but only lasts for 1 second after being inflicted on an enemy or Helldiver. * Burning Heavy also benefits from fire damage multipliers (such as the [[Enhanced Combustion]] ship module). {{Attack_Data/attack|status|BurningHeavy}} == Gas == Enemies and Helldivers afflicted by gas will suffer damage over time only to the Main health pool, as well as the Gas Confusion status effect on anything inside the gas cloud. The disorientation effect is delayed if the affected unit was already engaged in an attack motion (e.g. an [[Overseer]] chasing a Helldiver). ==== Gas Mk1 ==== * Duration: '''6''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry]], [[MD-8 Gas Mines]], [[G-4 Gas]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Eagle Gas Airstrike]], [[S-11 Speargun]] and [[P-35 Re-Educator]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas}} ==== Gas Mk2 ==== * Duration: '''10''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[TX-41 Sterilizer]], [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Var2}} == Gas Confusion== After being afflicted by Gas, enemies and Helldivers will enter a confused state which disrupts a Helldiver's vision, and causes enemies to move and attack in random directions, typically away from Helldivers. All units afflicted by gas are also slowed by 25%. ==== Gas Confusion Mk1 ==== * Duration: '''5''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry]], [[MD-8 Gas Mines]], [[G-4 Gas]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[S-11 Speargun]] and [[P-35 Re-Educator]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Confusion}} ==== Gas Confusion Mk2 ==== * Duration: '''9''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[TX-41 Sterilizer]], [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Confusion_Var2}} == Stun == Enemies hit by stunning attacks will be unable to move or attack for a short time. Helldivers become severely slowed down. ==== Stun 1 [Small]==== * Duration: '''1.5''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[ARC-12 Blitzer]], [[ARC-3 Arc Thrower]], [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]], [[AX/ARC-3 "Guard Dog" K-9]], [[G-31 Arc|G-31 Arc grenade]], [[GL-52 De-Escalator]], [[CQC-9 Defoliation Tool]], [[G-11 Caltrops]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Small}} ==== Stun 2 [Medium]==== * Duration: '''3.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/M-23 EMS Mortar Sentry]], [[SMG-72 Pummeler]], [[AR-32 Pacifier]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Medium}} ==== Stun 3 [Large] ==== * Duration: '''5.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[G-23 Stun]], [[G-109 Urchin]], [[SG-20 Halt]], [[CQC-19 Stun Lance]], [[CQC-30 Stun Baton]], [[CQC-1 One True Flag]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Large}} ==== Stun 4 [Massive] ==== * Duration: '''10.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[Stun Pods]] booster. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Massive}} ==== EMS Stun ==== The [[Orbital_EMS_Strike|Orbital EMS Strike]] Stratagem, [[EMS_Mortar_Sentry|EMS Mortar Sentry]] Emplacement, and [[SEAF Artillery]] Static Field Shells inflict a special variant of Stun which creates a ''cloud of static'' that renders most enemies unable to move. Helldivers are severely slowed down and lose stamina while within EMS Stun clouds. == Poison == Poison refers to three separate statuses: Poison, Heavy Poison, and Poison Vulnerability. All three can only be inflicted by the [[Noxious Strain]]. === Poison and Heavy Poison === Poison and Heavy Poison are fairly similar in the fact that they both deal {{Damage|Acid|2/s Normal and 5/s Durable Acid Damage|notext}} for 6 seconds. The primary difference is in the fact that Heavy Poison blurs the player's screen for the duration. The true amount of damage dealt, however, is dependent on the amount of Poison Vulnerability stacks.
{{Attack_Data/attack|status|Poison}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Poison_Heavy}}
=== Poison Vulnerability === Poison Vulnerability multiplies the damage dealt by both Poison effects with each stack. * The poison damage is multiplied by 1.4x at 1 stack of Poison Vulnerability * Multiplied by 1.8x at 2 stacks * Multiplied by 2.8x at 3 stacks * Multiplied by 4.2x at 4 stacks This status effect only stacks up to four. Stimming will reduce the amount of stacks by 2, but will not stop the poison statuses from dealing damage. Additionally, from three stacks of vulnerability and onwards, when poison is applied, the Helldiver will lose their ability to sprint for the duration of the poison. '''Stimming does not help recover from the loss of sprinting''', therefore it is recommended to not let Poison Vulnerability stack more than twice. The inability to sprint does not affect stamina reserves. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.202|changes= Addition * Added the Poison, Heavy Poison and Poison Vulnerability status effects. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Changes * Fire will now cause slowing effects and confusion effects on small to medium sized enemies }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Changes * Fire has been reworked to deal damage based on the "Size" of the enemy ** Small enemies take less burning damage and Larger enemies take more burning damage * Large and Robotic Enemies require more burning status buildup before being ignited Undocumented Changes * Burn damage increased from 50 to 100. * Heavy Burn armor penetration increased from {{Armor|2|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} * Heavy Burn standard damage decreased from 400 to 200 * Heavy Burn durable damage increased from 80 to 200 }} {{Change History Update|1.002.101|changes= Changes * The [[TX-41 Sterilizer]] & [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]] now Inflict "Gas MKII", with a longer effect duration (6s to 10s) }} {{Change History Update|1.001.100|changes= Changes * Reduced Gas Damage from 50 to 25 Gas DPS * Added confusion to the Gas status effect }} {{Change History Update|1.000.400|changes= Changes * The acid effect applied by Caustic Spitters and other Terminids now allows you to sprint while under the effect. * Acid now slows movement speed by 30% instead of 50%. * Acid duration increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds. * [[Spike Plant]]s no longer causes bleed or stamina drain if hit by the plant explosion or spikes. }} {{Change History Update|1.000.300|changes= Change * Burning damage reduced by 15%. ** Reduced Burning Damage from 60 to 50 Fire DPS }} {{Change History Update|1.000.200|changes= Change * Fire damage per tick increased by 50% (from all sources). ** Increased Burning Damage from 40 to 60 Fire DPS }} [[Category:Helldivers 2]] [[Category:Game Mechanics]] '''Exostorms''' are interstellar {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]] meteorological abnormalities that cause planetary weather to rapidly spike and intensify. These Exostorms have [[The Void|enormous consequences]] for space-time when not dealt with.

== Lore ==
{{Quote|Massive uncanny storms have erupted on this planet. These "Exostorms" emanate from otherworldly spires, unearthed by the Illuminate from the ruins of their fallen empire.|Partial Operation description of a '''Quell Exostorm''' Operation}}
{{Quote|Illuminate Exospires are channeling an aberrant Exostorm that rages on the surface of this world. The planet is at risk of being consumed by the Void, unless we act now.|Partial Operation description of an '''Avert Void''' Operation}}
Exostorms are caused by newly dug-up [[Destroy Exospire|Exospires]] located in Illuminate ruins. They send a purple beam into the sky, which stirs the weather up inside the mission area and beyond. Exostorms also affect the atmospheric integrity of the planet they are caused on.

Exospires are powered via an underground core fueled by [[Dark Fluid]] and protected by a shield generated by generators located in other nearby sites.

== Exostorm Classifications ==
=== Class 1 ===
{{Quote|Isolated Exostorm pockets are materializing across the planet and rapidly gaining momentum.|Class 1 Exostorm description}}

Class 1 Exostorms is the first Exostorm classification which begins after multiple Exospires have been activated.

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class One Exostorms, most weather-related [[Environmental Conditions]] a planet harbors will be permanently active. Lightning will rarely strike the ground after a short, but visible warning. The sky will also gain a massive slow-rotating cloud around the mission area.

* '''In-Orbit''' - The dark particles will begin exiting the atmosphere and entering into orbit, coating space near the planet in streaks of purple. The extensive weather effects can also be seen from space in the form of storms and vortexes.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - On the galactic war map, a small purple vortex will appear beneath the planet. When enlarged on the galactic table, the planet will be colored in a purple hue while radiating streaks of purple outwards of the planet. The planet will also be displayed with small purple pockets.

=== Class 2 ===
{{Quote|Exostorm fronts are coalescing into a dense system that threatens to engulf the entire planet.|Class 2 Exostorm description}}

Class 2 Exostorms are more severe variants of Exostorms, now featuring tornados. They usually increase from Class 1 to Class 2 after 72 hours of an Exostorm beginning.

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class Two Exostorms, lightning strikes will become more common. Tornados will begin occasionally roaming the mission area, lifting items, living being and corpses into the air. Wind will also begin occasionally appearing on the surface. The massive cloud around the mission area will begin rotating faster. Vortexes will begin appearing outside the mission area, moving around slowly.

* '''In-Orbit''' - Many more dark particles will begin entering orbit as the purple streaks of energy intensify. The vortexes and storm clouds forming over the planet will begin growing in size.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - The vortex beneath the planet in the galactic map will grow in size slightly. When enlarged on the galactic table, the radiant streaks of purple will intensify and grow in size, and the purple pockets displayed on the surface will increase in size and amount.

=== Class 3 ===
{{Quote|The Exostorm has reached critical mass, enveloping the planet in an ominous tempest that defies atmospheric physics.|Class 3 Exostorm description}}

Class 3 Exostorms are the final stage of an Exostorm, they are more intense than Class 1 and 2 Exostorms and feature spacetime tears. They usually increase from Class 2 to Class 3 after 120 hours of an Exostorm beginning. 

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class Three Exostorms, lightning strikes will be extremely common. The deadly tornados first seen in Class 2 become more common. Wind, while slow in earlier stages, now becomes perpetual and fast, in which a Helldiver's cape will not stop waving. The clouds will continue to rotate faster. Purple visual artifacts will now be extremely common. Tornados will continue to appear as in Class 2.
* '''In-Orbit''' - The dark particles reaching into the orbit will once again exponentially intensify and increase in size, erratically radiating purple streaks of energy. The vortexes and storm clouds over the planet will all have merged into one giant superstorm covering most, if not all of the planet at once.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - The vortex beneath the planet on the galactic map will grow further, now spinning faster than before. When the planet is enlarged on the galactic table, the radiant streaks of purple intensify and grow further, and the purple pockets over the displayed surface will further increase in size. The outline of the displayed planet's hologram will also now become a deep purple. Within the [[Super Destroyer]], lights on the Bridge will turn a red/orange color.

* '''In-Lore''' - During Class Three Exostorms, fluctuations to the chronometric drift will start to occur, affecting the passage of time. Spacetime fractures will also envelop the planet's system, quickly compromising spacetime stability. Class Three Exostorms directly affect reality itself, slowly deteriorating it until the planet is plunged into the Void.

== The Void ==
''Main article: [[The Void]]''

After a planet has endured prolonged time covered by a Class 3 Exostorm and the enemy occupation rate reaches 100%, an impenetrable Void spanning hundreds of light years will form around the planet and the local system. The Void does not radiate any energy signatures and any probes sent in lose contact immediately after entering.

Any Helldivers stationed over a planet engulfed by the Void will be emergency FTL warped to [[Super Earth]], and will have any leftover Operations ceased as travel to the planet becomes impossible.

While the phenomenon was first observed around the [[Seasse]] system, the Void had spread to encompass over two dozen planets across the Illuminate front before it was collapsed on August 23rd 2186.

== Unique Effects ==
* '''Perpetual Meteorological Effects''' - Exostorms severely affect and intensify the weather of a harboring planet. For example on a [[Basic Swamp]] planet, it will perpetually rain as Basic Swamp biomes have the [[Rainstorms|Torrential Rainstorms]] environmental modifier active.
** Certain environmental effects will be missing completely, such as [[Acid Storms]] on [[Acidic Badlands]] planets, which are instead replaced by an unmarked Rainstorms effect.
** Geological environmental effects aren't spared either, with the [[Tremors]] effect missing completely from planets harboring them.
* '''Lightning''' - On Exostorm planets, lightning will occasionally strike the surface. While not outright deadly, lightning will deal some damage, as well as activating a short stun effect. A warning sign for a strike zone are particles, light, and warping around the strike zone.
** Note that at least during Class Three Exostorms, lightning strikes are deadly to most Helldivers wearing [[Medium|Medium Armor]] or lower.
* '''Wind''' - Wind can be seen on the surface. It does not negatively or positively affect any Helldivers or Enemies, however [[capes]] may begin to wave.
* '''Visual Artifacts''' - Purple visual artifacts caused by spacetime fractures can be seen around the mission area, appearing before shortly disappearing. While rare during Class One and Two Exostorms, they are very common during Class Three Exostorms.
* '''Tornados''' - Massive tornados can be seen roaming the surface in the mission area starting in Class Two Exostorms. These tornados lift up objects, living beings and corpses into the air, which is deadly for anything and anyone caught in one. Tornados become more common in Class Three Exostorms.

=== Environmental Changes ===
* From orbit, strands of purple energy can be seen leaving the atmosphere.
* The atmosphere will be filled with storm clouds similar to those found as hurricanes.
** These can be seen from orbit as massive covering clouds, or from the surface as if the mission area was inside the eye of the storm.
* The planet's surface will gain a faint, noticeable purple hue, rarely intensifying before returning back to usual.
** This effect is not caused by anything on the surface, but rather by the purple streaks in orbit which shine down onto the mission area.
* Light blue particles can be found floating around the surface of the planet.

=== Biome-specific Changes ===
While on most biomes Exostorms will have a normal effect that can be standardized, certain Biomes also receive unique changes during Exostorms.

* [[Desert Dunes]]: Both the [[Intense Heat]] and [[Extreme Cold]] environmental effects are completely removed. The [[Sandstorms]] modifier is also partially removed, not being present as an environmental effect, but present as an unmarked, permanent variant. This new sandstorm is less potent than its original form, but still lowers visibility exponentially, which affects enemies as well.
* [[Desert Cliffs]]: Both the [[Intense Heat]] and [[Tremors]] environmental effects are completely removed, and are instead replaced by an unmarked and lighter version of [[sandstorms]]. As part of this, the biome gains slightly thicker fog as grains of sand quickly fly through the air.
* [[Acidic Badlands]]: The [[Acid Storms]] effect is replaced by normal rainstorms, though they will not appear as an Environmental Condition in the effects tab. The usual thick fog will disappear and instead be replaced by a light purple fog present on other Exostorm biomes. When an Exostorm is destroyed, almost all the fog disappears, leading to a completely clear and fogless Acidic Badlands.
* [[Volcanic Jungle]]: The [[Volcanic Activity]] environmental modifier remains active and plays out as usual. As the effect is (likely) geological, destroying an Exospire to negate the exostorm's effects does not remove the possibility of volcanic rocks crashing onto the mission area.
* [[Deadlands]]: Unlike on other exostorm planets, exostorms on Deadlands planets do not feature any rain whatsoever. The usual fog is still present though with a more purple tint, followed by constant wind.
* [[Ethereal Jungle]] and [[Ionic Jungle]]: This biome features no rain or otherwise similar unmarked environmental effects. Fog is slightly thicker than usual and is combined with constant wind.
* [[Icy Glaciers]]: The [[Blizzards]] modifier is changed slightly, being permanently present. Unlike the original environmental effect, this blizzard does not affect movement, though it still lowers visibility exponentially. The lowered visibility affects enemies as well.
* [[Scorched Moor]]: The biome has no rain due to the heat, and instead features strong winds and a thick "ashen" fog. Notably, the [[Fire Tornados]] environmental effect unique to this biome is only present in the mission backdrop instead of as an active hazard.

'''Heavy SEAF Presence''' is a [[Effects|Modifier]] that allows SEAF squads to be deployed via [[Pelican Shuttle]]s to the mission area.

== Overview ==
The modifier was introduced as part of [[Campaigns#Void Piercer|Operation Void Piercer]]. On any planets where this modifier is active, SEAF soldiers will be deployed in missions via Pelican Shuttles.

Following [[Campaigns#Blazing Electorate|Blazing Electorate's]] failure on September 21st, 2026, {{PAGENAME}} was made unavailable. It was later added back on October 11th, 2026.<ref>"WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT - SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory." - Dispatch issued during [[Major Order#A3-10-3|Major Order A3-10-3]]</ref>

== Spawning ==
* Pelican Shuttles will periodically fly in to deploy up to 3 Squads of [[SEAF Soldier]]s to the mission area. Helldivers will know when this happens, as Mission Control will inform them.
** SEAF Squads are deployed on Helldivers fighting large amounts (estimated 20+) of enemies, or on enemy reinforcement call-ins. If neither is true, the SEAF Squads will remain in reserve.
** While there is a limit to the total active SEAF Squads deployed in a mission, there is no limit to the SEAF Squads in reserve. Pelican Shuttles will never run out of fresh SEAF Squads to deploy.

== Tactical Information==
* SEAF Soldiers deployed via this modifier always come in a general Squad composition consisting of 1 Squad Leader, 2 Riflemen, 2 Specialists, and 1 Medic. The SEAF Soldiers will follow their Squad Leader.
** For a proper description of these roles, please visit their [[SEAF Soldier|respective page]].
** Each deployed SEAF Soldier is always marked on the Helldivers mini-map with the small green dot.
* Each SEAF Soldier killed by direct actions of a Helldiver immediately deducts {{Currency|Requisition|25}} from the current amount for the [[Missions|Mission]]. This includes Soldiers killed by automated [[Stratagems]] such as the [[AX/AR-23 "Guard Dog"]] and [[A/G-16 Gatling Sentry]].
**The Pelican Shuttles that deploy the SEAF Soldiers often do so close to the Helldivers' position. As such, Helldivers should be aware of where they throw their Eagles, Orbitals, and Sentries to not kill the SEAF soldiers.
*** Pelican Shuttles will hold their descent if the area they are above is currently on fire or has any kind of offensive stratagem deployed. They will resume descending once the fire has dissipated or the offensive stratagem has ended.
** If a Helldiver is caught 9 times recklessly killing SEAF Soldiers or [[Civilian]]s, they will be branded as a traitor. As such, the [[Super Destroyer]] will begin firing [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|380mm HE Shells]] at the Helldiver until they are killed. Mines will not add to the traitor tally but will still deduct Requisition Slips.
* The [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]] does not react to SEAF Soldiers in its proximity. However, if an arc is triggered by someone else, it will still kill the SEAF Soldier.

== Trivia ==
* Although their default armor consists of the iconic light blue paint, save for the Medics, depending on the biome and super-structure, they will wear camo related to it.
** If they are on a Desert planet, such as a [[Desert Oasis]] biome like [[Fronteria]], they will be equipped with a desert-camo pattern.
* When SEAF squads were first added to the game, they are marked on the map as green dots, making them the first Ally NPCs to be identified on the map.
* Even when time has run out, Pelican Shuttles will keep spawning in and bring in fresh squads of SEAF Soldiers.
